title: the Astral Plane
audit_comment: the Astral Plane, printed pp. 60-72, the whole chapter in one round: the barren-vault doctrine (the transit plane between Primes and outers, the wormholes, Anubis the sole resident Power), the reaching split (the astral-spell projection with the silver cords vs. the plane-shift physical travel), the cord rules (the 1d10-turn dissolution clock, the 1d4+1-day coma with the system-shock and half-hp restrictions, the 1% possession, the three severing forces), the color pools (the 10-60 foot disks, the blind side, the d20 color table, the 1d4x100-yard viewing altitude, the percentile location roll, the 10-times-Intelligence viewpoint, the 15% two-way and 5% fixed portals), the survival (no breath, no food, the 365,000-to-1 time, the potion permanence, the dead infravision), the movement (the 10-yards-per-minute-per-Int mental move, the push-off fallback, the encumbrance), the 1d10-every-four-hours encounter check with the 1-75/76-85/86-95/96-00 type split, the psychic wind (the 1d20 group roll with the wake, the 2d10-day stranding, the cross-current, the cord-snapping storm), the combat (the AC 8 astral base, the Intelligence and Wisdom modifier swap, the above/below rules, the doubled missile ranges, the suspended healing, the liquid films and suspended poison), the magic (the conjuration caps at 4th/3rd/5th, the sphere areas, the extradimensional void, the Bigby-hand Intelligence contests, the illusion and necromancy rules, the searcher chance at 5 times level), the PC adjustments (the thief noise split, the ranger tracking, the monk AC 7), and the features (the githyanki silver swords at AC 0 and 20%, the lich-queen, the astral searchers, the fixed portals, Yggdrasil and Mount Olympus).

banner.title: THE ASTRAL PLANE - printed pp. 60-72, the whole chapter in one round: the barren vault between the Primes and the outer planes - the silver cords, the color pools, the thought-movement, the psychic wind, the weightless combat, the magic limits, and the githyanki with their silver swords.
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 60-72 of the uploaded motp.pdf OCR; the chapter pins carry the projection/physical travel split, the cord and pool mechanics, the encounter and wind tables, and the school-by-school magic limits exactly as printed.
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 53 closed, 37 open - ELEVEN boxes fall (the chapter parent, the eight section children, the encounter check, the sample charts); the outer planes general doctrine opens the final arc next.

consts.name: ddeTimeRatio
consts.comment: the Astral time ratio: the effects of time slow by 365,000 to 1 (170 true days to one subjective round) - the slowest subjective time of all the known major planes; spells run their normal duration in true time; aging attacks (ghosts, staff of withering) have no effect.

consts.name: ddeCordDissolveTurns
consts.comment: the silver cord snap: the astral form dissolves in 1d10 turns, the Prime body perishes irrecoverable save wishes, artifacts return intact - but reaching a color pool and forming a new body before the clock runs out averts death; the same 1d10-turn clock rules a slain physical body (the cord disappears, the character dies).

consts.name: ddeAstralComaDays
consts.comment: the slain-astral-form coma: 1d4+1 (5) days, awakened only by a full wish or alter reality; then a system shock roll - failure is death, success wakes at 1 hit point, no spellcasting, half movement and -4 attacks until half hit points are regained WITHOUT magic (true time).

consts.name: ddePossessionPct
consts.comment: the possession danger: a 1% chance per venture into the Astral that an extradimensional creature (magic jar class) possesses the abandoned physical body - the cord is NOT cut, visible to true seeing; the owner cannot re-enter until the intruder leaves or is exorcised.

consts.name: ddeMentalMoveBase
consts.comment: mental movement: 10 yards per minute (30 feet per melee round) per point of Intelligence, at will with free stops and turns; groups move at the lowest Intelligence; encumbrance costs 10 feet per round per 10 lbs (100 gp), magical items weigh nothing; physical push-off movement is the clumsy fallback (10 feet per round off a large object, Strength-based off small ones).

consts.name: ddeEncounterCheckHours
consts.comment: the Astral encounter check: 1d10 rolled on entrance and every four true hours thereafter - a 1 means an encounter; type split 1-75 creature, 76-85 color pool, 86-95 astral item, 96-00 psychic wind; pool viewing adds a 5% chance per check that the portal opens beside an astral-affecting native.

consts.name: ddeConduitBothEndsPct
consts.comment: the astral conduits (wormholes): 80% have functioning gates at both ends (50% chance each way out, never to a plane holding the projector's body); the other 20% are one-way (being spun or sundered); unlike pools they reach the DEEPER layers - the only safe road into the lower Abyss.

consts.name: ddeConduitPullYards
consts.comment: the conduit attraction: within 1,000 yards a wormhole pulls travelers at 120 yards per round; those who cannot outpace it (Intelligence 11 or less) are dragged in and transported; cord-severed travelers sucked in do NOT die - they gain a new body where they land.

consts.name: ddeWindDelayHours
consts.comment: the psychic wind wake: 1d4+2 (6) hours added to travel (astral) or 1d4+2 hours unable to leave save by color pool (physical) - the 1-12 band of the 1d20 group roll; 13-16 lost for 2d10 true days, 17-19 cross-current (50% wrong pool or within 1,000 yards of a wormhole), 20 the storm - save vs. spell or the cord snaps.

consts.name: ddePoolTwoWayPct
consts.comment: the color pool traffic rule: only 15% of pools are two-way (movable, and so often eliminated or controlled); of those, 5% are FIXED portals - permanent, undisppellable, same spot, set exit, surface layers only; one-way pools vanish after passage (recreatable from the far side).

consts.name: ddeSearcherLevelMult
consts.comment: the astral searcher danger: a failed restoration of spirit to a body (raise dead, magic jar) draws a searcher at 5 times the body's previously highest level on percentile dice (an 18th-level magic-user's failed raise dead = 90%); the searcher gains the body's hit points and physical abilities but not its class knowledge.

consts.name: ddeTrueSightStunBase
consts.comment: the panorama stun: true sight and gems of seeing reveal the infinite Astral - the stun chance is 100% minus 5% per level, immobilizing for the spell's duration (1d8 true turns via device); also detect magic: the whole plane radiates magic, normal enchantments discerned only 5% of the time.

consts.name: ddeClericConjLevelCap
consts.comment: the conjuration/summoning caps: clerical spells of 4th level or higher do not function; druidical 3rd or higher; magic-user and illusionist 5th or higher - save spells linked with abjuration (prismatic wall) or purely verbal (power word, death spell exception); Power-intervention spells work only for Astral-native powers (Anubis).

consts.name: ddeDruidConjLevelCap
consts.comment: the druidical summoning cap: 3rd level or higher does not work (animal summoning fails, fire seeds works - conjuration only); summoning cantrips never operate; druidical spell recovery needs an Astral-resident deity or a faster-time haven, save the cleric's meditative true-time rest.

consts.name: ddeMuConjLevelCap
consts.comment: the magic-user/illusionist summoning cap: 5th level or higher fails unless abjuration-linked or verbal-only; combination spells take BOTH restrictions except abjuration-plus-conjuration/summoning (the conjuration limits ignored).

bools.name: ddeSilverCordRule
bools.comment: the silver cord: visible 10 feet behind the astral form then invisible and intangible, stretched to any length; severed only by the psychic wind at its most powerful, githyanki silver swords, or the will of a Lesser/Greater Power; the astral form is a solid translucent white body - magical items and enchanted gear come along, the rest stays; voluntary return takes 1d100 melee rounds (delayable by psychic wind); group cords chain through the caster - his cord dooms all.

bools.name: ddeColorPoolDoctrine
bools.comment: the color pools: 10-60 foot rippling disks, one-sided (a 1-in-10 per-encounter blind-side miss without detect invisible); the d20 color table (Concordant Opposition leather brown to Ethereal spiraling white) with silver ALWAYS the home Prime; viewing needs concentration within 30 feet - the point rides 1d4x100 yards above the surface, location by percentile (1-50 on target, 96-00 way off), fixed for one Prime day, moving at 10 times Intelligence in yards per round, forward only, slowed to 10 yards per turn in magic-rich areas.

bools.name: ddePoolAttackRule
bools.comment: the pool battle: gaze creatures (basilisks, gorgons, cockatrices) perceive portals and strike through them - physical attackers strike the viewing point at AC 0, all viewers within 30 feet save vs. petrification or be affected (astral forms become astral stone); a dispel magic from the far side (50% plus the level difference) sucks viewers through; the pool viewer is otherwise immune to the viewed plane.

bools.name: ddeSurvivalDoctrine
bools.comment: the survival: no breathing (respiratory attacks like cloudkill useless; gorgon breath and insinuative poison still work), no food or drink (hunger at ~300 subjective years), potions permanent while on the plane, vision 1,000-2,000 yards (infravision dead, ultravision doubled), no gravity or direction - motion continues till it hits something.

bools.name: ddeWeightlessCombat
bools.comment: the combat: astral base AC 8 (nonmagical armor gives nothing, magical pluses reduced by 1), Intelligence gives the to-hit and damage mods (PH Strength table) and Wisdom the AC and bow mods (PH Dexterity table), Strength and Dexterity are irrelevant; attacks from above negate shields (helm saves), from below count as rear attacks (backstabs); missiles fly flat - doubled range, -2 for the first 2-5 shots; natural healing is suspended for non-natives.

bools.name: ddeLiquidAndPoisonRule
bools.comment: the liquid and poison rules: weightless liquids film the whole body - double damage, and a filmed victim drowns in 1d4 melee rounds if he speaks (no verbal spells without water breathing); poison saves are rolled but effects suspend until the victim reaches a faster-time plane (insinuative poisons the worst); potions in vials take 1d4 rounds to drink with a 5% choke, wineskins drink in one round.

bools.name: ddeExtradimensionalVoid
bools.comment: the void doctrine: the Astral has NO extradimensional space - rope trick, vanish, deep pockets fail; a portable hole either does not open (50%) or becomes a huge ordinary bag (50%); no egress to the Ethereal or inner planes save ether cyclones, so Ethereal-touching spells fail; flat spell areas become spheres of the lesser dimension, walls become hollow spheres of 10 feet plus 2.5 per level.

bools.name: ddeIllusionNecromancyRule
bools.comment: the illusion and necromancy rules: phantasms without illusionary components fail (phantom wind, phantom speed); phantasmal forces work and read MORE believable; necromantics function normally - a failed raise dead draws an astral searcher; a clone grows at 1 day per 1,000 subjective years (useless); animate-object alterations give the object Intelligence 0 movement but it can strike.

bools.name: ddeBigbyHandRule
bools.comment: the Bigby hands vs mental movers: interposing hand stops the less intelligent and halves the rest; forceful hand's push resolves by the Intelligence difference (equal = no movement); grasping hand interposes when the caster is dimmer, repels double-strength when brighter; clenched fist and crushing hand function normally - the hands carry the caster's own hit points and Armor Class.

bools.name: ddeThiefAdjustments
bools.comment: the PC adjustments: thieves keep abilities - the plane self-lights so few shadows exist, hear noise +10%, move silently -10%, climb walls unpenalized on solids; rangers lose their surprise-protection but keep the 3-in-6 surprise, tracking only on solid islands; barbarian abilities fail (only 6th level or higher come willingly); monks hold AC 7 or better astrally and move at 18 Intelligence from 10th level; cavaliers and paladins ride ki-rin, dragon horses and nightmares.

bools.name: ddeGithyankiSilverSwords
bools.comment: the githyanki: the silver swords (+3 two-handed) and special silver swords (+5, vocal) are the ONLY physical weapons that sever cords - hit the cord at AC 0, then a 20% sever chance (mind bar blocks silver, not special); their 96 movement and continual probability travel make their own color pools unusable to them; knights are evil cavaliers, cities reach 1,000 souls, and the lich-queen (24th-30th level) is a Demi-Power who cannot yet grant spells.

bools.name: ddeYggdrasilOlympus
bools.comment: the permanent conduits: Yggdrasil the World Ash runs Gladsheim to Niflheim (the Glooms of Hades), Mount Olympus links the plane of Olympus to the Primes with exits into lower Gehenna, Hades and Tarterus - solid, permanent, weathering the fortunes of gods, ending in fixed-portal pools; Anubis is the only Power making his home in the Astral.
